reviews.reason: The first rook drops from e8 to e6 and returns only after the second rook drives the king off g7.
reviews.distinctness: A rook returns to its starting square after the second rook clears the g-file.
reviews.solutionVi: Ván đấu ghi đến Re6+ Kg7 Rg5+. Trong phương án phân tích, Vua Đen đi Kf8 hoặc Kh8 đều gặp Re8#. Xe g5 khóa đường trở lại g7.
hintsVi: Tìm nước chiếu đưa Vua Đen về cột g.
Khi Vua rời cột g, dùng một Xe giữ cột đó và Xe kia chiếu trên hàng 8.

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: The first rook drops from e8 to e6 and returns only after the second rook drives the king off g7.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: The only forced root in three is Re6+ among 37 moves. Re8 immediately cannot achieve the mate.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: After the forced Kg7, Rg5+ allows Kf8 and Kh8. Both lose to Re8# and the g5 rook prevents Kg7. No capture of either rook is available.
reviewNotes.level: Three attacker turns, with a temporary reposition and the g-file cut before the final mate.
reviewNotes.provenance: TWIC records Re6+ Kg7 Rg5+ before play ends. The last two moves are verified analysis.

reviews.reason: Equal-material rook ending with a unique three-move mate. The extra check earns the final seventh-rank arrangement.
reviews.distinctness: The first rook moves g7–h7 to turn the king around. The other rook enters g7 only after that change of roles. Compare with Carlsen–Andreikin A, where the first rook can go straight to h7.
reviews.solutionVi: Ván đấu ghi đến Rh7+. Trong phương án phân tích, sau Kg8, Xe a7 đến g7 chiếu hết. Xe h7 giữ ô h8 và bảo vệ Xe g7.
hintsVi: Hai Xe Trắng đang cùng hàng. Tìm nước chiếu buộc Vua Đen vào h8.
Sau khi Xe chiếu chuyển sang h7, hãy đưa Xe còn lại vào ô g7.

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: Removing h7 allows Kh8 or Kxg7. The other rook delivers the adjacent-file check from g7.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: All 27 roots reviewed. Only Rg7+ forces mate in the allotted three turns. Neither side has a material concession on the proved route.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: Kh8 and Kg8 are the only replies to the first and second checks, respectively. Neither rook can be captured in this sequence.
reviewNotes.level: B. The extra check is needed to change the rook arrangement. No shorter mate or sacrifice.
reviewNotes.provenance: TWIC 1662 GM–GM complete score. The position follows 56...fxg6. The original score ends after Rh7+, and the continuation is explicitly analysis.

reviews.reason: Be6+ drives the king to f8. The c7 rook cuts off the seventh rank and also punishes a rook interposition on c8.
reviews.distinctness: Quiet removal of the defending rook after a bishop check, with a c8 interposition changing the mating move.
reviews.solutionVi: Be6+ Kf8 Rxc7. Xe c7 giữ hàng 7. Trong phương án phân tích, sau ...h5, Rh8# chiếu hết. Nếu ...Rc8 che hàng 8, Trắng đáp Rxc8#. Ván đấu dừng sau Rxc7.
hintsVi: Dùng Tượng đưa Vua Đen lên hàng 8.
Sau khi bắt Xe ở c7, tính cả nước Xe Đen che đường chiếu trên hàng 8.

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: Be6+ drives the king to f8. The c7 rook cuts off the seventh rank and also punishes a rook interposition on c8.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: Only Be6+ forces mate in three. Immediate moves with either rook do not force the same payoff.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: Rxc7 removes a rook. After ...Rc8, use Rxc8# instead of Rh8#. ...Nxg2 takes a pawn, and the solver still has a net gain from Rxc7 before mating.
reviewNotes.level: Three turns including a bishop check and a quiet rook capture to secure the mating net.
reviewNotes.provenance: PGN Mentor records Be6+ Kf8 Rxc7; the rest of the sample and the ...Rc8 branch are analysis.

reviews.reason: Discovered rook check opens a line that two different pieces can block. The three-move payoff remains valid across these interpositions.
reviews.distinctness: Bishop departure reveals the rook. A defending rook blocks on g3, or the knight blocks on g7 or g5, so the choice of capturing rook changes.
reviews.solutionVi: Trong phương án phân tích, Bb1+ mở cột g cho Xe g2. Sau Rg3, Trắng chơi Rxg3+ Ng7 Rgxg7#. Nếu Đen chắn ngay bằng Ng7, Trắng dùng Xe h7 bắt Mã, rồi chiếu hết bằng Rg8#.
hintsVi: Tượng g6 đang chắn đường chiếu của Xe g2. Hãy tìm cách mở cột g.
Nếu Đen dùng Xe hoặc Mã chắn cột g, hãy xác định Xe nào có thể bắt quân chắn.

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: The bishop uncovers the first rook check. In the sample finish h7 protects g7 and covers h8; in the immediate Ng7 branch the h7 rook captures and the g2 rook later backs up the mate.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: All 40 roots reviewed. Five bishop departures force mate in three, including the played Bf5+. There is no forced shorter mate or root that bypasses the rooks.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: After Bb1+, Rg3, Ng7 and Ng5 are all covered. After Rg3 Rxg3+, both Ng7 and Ng5 are covered. The solver gains material on captures without offering either rook.
reviewNotes.level: B. Discovering the check is accessible, but the solver must handle several blocking choices over three moves.
reviewNotes.provenance: Complete Kramnik PGN Mentor archive game, 63rd move after ...Ra6. The game ends after Bf5+; the presented Bb1+ route is explicitly analysis.

reviews.reason: Two pawn captures drive the king from b1 to a1 and back while the second rook stays on a6 to cut off the final escape.
reviews.distinctness: The learner must use the same rook twice, despite both rooks being able to capture a2. Moving the wrong rook allows defensive captures and removes the final cutoff.
reviews.solutionVi: Rxb2+ buộc Vua Trắng sang a1. Sau Rbxa2+ Kb1, Xe trở về b2 chiếu hết. Xe a6 vẫn giữ cột a nên Vua không thể chạy lại a1.
hintsVi: Tính nước bắt Tốt b2 có chiếu. Vua Trắng còn ô nào?
Khi bắt Tốt a2, chọn Xe sao cho cột a vẫn bị khóa ở thế chiếu hết.

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: The b2 rook gives the final check. The stationary a6 rook controls a1, an actual escape without it.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: Rxb2+ is the only forced mate in three among 38 roots. A quiet rook move gives White time to defend. After Ka1, Raxa2+ instead permits Qxa2 or Nxa2.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: The certified line covers Ka1 and Kb1, the only defensive replies at their respective nodes. The solver captures two pawns and loses no material.
reviewNotes.level: Exactly three solver moves. The choice of which rook captures a2 is short coordination with a clear defensive consequence.
reviewNotes.provenance: Black FM header in the Amsterdam Chess Open in TWIC 1668. Full replay matches ply 43 after Bxd2 and all five displayed moves were played.

reviews.reason: The immediate capture on g7 establishes a protected rook and is stronger than taking the other rook on e8.
reviews.distinctness: Choosing which enemy rook to take first matters. The two friendly rooks convert a three-check capture sequence through a knight interposition.
reviews.solutionVi: Ván đấu ghi đến Rxg7+ Kf8 Rxf6+. Trong phương án phân tích, nếu Đen chắn bằng Nf7, Trắng đáp Rfxf7#. Xe g7 bảo vệ Xe f7 và khống chế g8.
hintsVi: Trắng có thể bắt Xe Đen ở hai nơi. So sánh vị trí của Vua Đen sau mỗi nước chiếu.
Sau khi Vua Đen đến f8, tìm cách dùng Xe còn lại để chiếu dọc cột f.

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: The rook on g7 denies Kg8 and Kxf7, while the rook on f7 checks. The h6-pawn protects g7 before the final move.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: Rxe8+ and Rxf6 do not force mate within three. Rxg7+ is the only root with a mate inside the requested bound.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: Kf8 and Nf7 are the legal replies in sequence. The solver takes a rook and two knights, and makes no material concession.
reviewNotes.level: B: three solver moves are required against the legal replies, with short preparation or coordination and no sacrifice.
reviewNotes.provenance: 2nd 3-0 Thu 20th Aug 2026, 2026.08.20, round 4. Replayed the complete indexed game to ply 70 and checked the preceding Rxg7. Preserved the original game and the archive checksum (https://theweekinchess.com/zips/twic1659g.zip). The analysis continuation differs from the original recorded game.

reviews.reason: The queen drives the king to the h-file. The e3 rook cuts off g3 while the h-file rook delivers the check and takes the blocker.
reviews.distinctness: Queen check draws the king to the edge before the two-rook finish.
reviews.solutionVi: Phương án phân tích là Qd1+ Kh4 Rh1+ Qh2 Rxh2#. Xe e3 giữ ô g3, còn Xe h2 bắt Hậu đang che đường chiếu và chiếu hết.
hintsVi: Dùng Hậu đưa Vua Đen về cột h.
Xe e3 giữ ô g3. Tính cách xử lý quân Đen che trên cột h.

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: The queen drives the king to the h-file. The e3 rook cuts off g3 while the h-file rook delivers the check and takes the blocker.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: Qd1+ is the only forced mate root in three out of 48. The played Rxe4+ is not a mate in three.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: Kh4 and Qh2 are the only replies in the proved sequence. Taking the blocking queen gives mate without conceding material.
reviewNotes.level: Three turns and one short forcing queen preparation, with direct rook coordination after it.
reviewNotes.provenance: Kramnik archive, Amber Rapid. Actual move at the source ply is Rxe4+, so the entire saved line is analysis.

reviews.reason: A quiet rook move keeps the seventh-rank barrier and gives the other rook two ways to deliver mate. The most resilient king reply needs a second quiet move.
reviews.distinctness: Quiet rank restriction with the king able to choose b8 or d8. The b8 reply changes which file the other rook must use.
reviews.solutionVi: Trong phương án phân tích, Rh7 giữ hàng 7 và dọa Ra8#. Nếu Đen đi Kb8, Trắng chuyển Xe a6 sang e6. Sau Ng6, Re8# chiếu hết, còn Xe h7 chặn đường Vua xuống hàng 7.
hintsVi: Xe trên hàng 7 đang ngăn Vua Đen thoát xuống. Hãy giữ hàng này và chuẩn bị đưa Xe kia lên hàng 8.
Nếu Vua Đen sang b8, tìm một cột khác để Xe a6 lên hàng 8.

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: At mate, the h7 rook prevents Kc7, Kb7 and Ka7, while the e8 rook checks across the eighth rank. The same seventh-rank restriction supports Ra8# in other branches.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: All 25 roots reviewed. Rf7, Rg7 and Rh7 all force mate in three. The tempting Rb8+ allows Kxb8 and cannot force the same short mate.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: Against Kb8, Re6 maintains the third-turn mate after all 11 legal replies. Against Kd8 and all non-king replies to Rh7, Ra8# is immediate. Material is unchanged.
reviewNotes.level: B. The quiet first move and the strongest king reply require one short adjustment, and there is no shorter force.
reviewNotes.provenance: Kramnik PGN Mentor archive, complete game. Rf7 Kb8 Re6 is recorded; Rh7 and the rest of the sample are clearly identified as analysis.

reviews.reason: Two knight checks first place the king on the h-file and then clear that file for a rook check, leaving both rooks essential to the finish.
reviews.distinctness: Knight clearance and discovered rook check set up the mate, with the supporting rook staying put throughout.
reviews.solutionVi: Phương án phân tích: Nh6+ đưa Vua vào h8. Nf5+ mở cột h cho Xe h3 chiếu, buộc Vua trở về g8. Rg7# kết thúc vì Xe h3 vẫn khống chế h8.
hintsVi: Tìm nước Mã chiếu để đưa Vua Đen vào góc h8.
Sau khi Mã tới h6, hãy tìm cách mở lại cột h cho Xe.

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: After Rg7#, the rook on h3 covers h8, which is otherwise a legal escape. Its discovered check also forces the king back to g8.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: Nh6+ is the only forced mate in three among 31 roots. The played Rh8+ allows Kg7; Nxd8 permits Rxd8 and other replies.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: The proof checks Kh8 after Nh6+ and Kg8 after Nf5+, each the only legal reply. No exchange or capture of an attacker is needed.
reviewNotes.level: Exactly three solver moves without a sacrifice. The knight first gives check itself and then clears the file for the second check.
reviewNotes.provenance: PGN Mentor Kramnik archive, with the existing post-title identity check. Full replay matches ply 80 after Kg8. The recorded move is Rh8+, so the sample is analysis.

reviews.reason: Moving the rook off g7 uncovers a bishop check that makes the defensive rook interpose, then the second rook cuts the back rank.
reviews.distinctness: Discovery and interposition on the g-file are the preparation. A back-rank rook and a bishop-backed rook finish from perpendicular lines.
reviews.solutionVi: Trắng chơi Rf7+ trong ván đấu, mở đường chéo f6–g7–h8 cho Tượng chiếu. Phương án chiếu hết là ...Rg7 Re8+ Kh7 Rxg7#. Xe e8 chặn ô h8, còn Tượng f6 bảo vệ Xe g7.
hintsVi: Xem Tượng f6 sẽ chiếu vào đâu nếu Xe g7 rời đường chéo.
Sau khi Xe Đen chắn ở g7, tìm cách dùng Xe còn lại để cắt hàng 8.

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: Rf7+ is discovered bishop check. At the finish Re8 stops Kh8 and Rxg7 checks. Bf6 protects the checking rook, so each of the three pieces has a separate duty.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: Rxg8+ and Rh7+ do not force mate in three. Engine also saw slower mates from Rg3+ and Rc7+, and the exact test ruled out any equivalent bypass.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: The only replies are Rg7 and Kh7. Rf7+ vacates g7, so ...Rg7 is an interposition, not a capture of a sacrificed rook.
reviewNotes.level: B: three solver moves are required against the legal replies, with short preparation or coordination and no sacrifice.
reviewNotes.provenance: 46th Olympiad 2026, 2026.09.16, round 1.21. Replayed the complete indexed game to ply 60 and checked the preceding Qxb4. Preserved the original game and the archive checksum (https://theweekinchess.com/zips/twic1663g.zip). The analysis continuation differs from the original recorded game.

reviews.reason: The quiet rook transfer threatens mate on h2; the g2 rook protects h2 and prevents Kg1.
reviews.distinctness: A quiet mate threat that must account for a countercheck and pawn advances.
reviews.solutionVi: Rh6 đe dọa Rhxh2#. Trong phương án phân tích, nếu Trắng chơi Bxh7+, Đen đáp Kxh7. Sau Rd2, Rhxh2# chiếu hết. Nếu Tốt h tiến, Xe có thể bắt Tốt ngay trên cột h để chiếu hết.
hintsVi: Tìm cách chuyển Xe sang cột h. Xe g2 sẽ bảo vệ ô nào?
Tính nước đáp nếu Trắng chiếu bằng Tượng ở h7.

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: The quiet rook transfer threatens mate on h2; the g2 rook protects h2 and prevents Kg1.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: Only Rh6 forces mate in three. No faster mate or mate in three with an unrelated piece pattern survives all replies.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: White can delay with Bxh7+, taking a pawn. Kxh7 removes the bishop and restores material. If the h-pawn advances, the moving rook takes it on h3 or h4 to mate instead.
reviewNotes.level: The quiet move threatens immediate mate, but one forcing countercheck requires a third solver turn.
reviewNotes.provenance: Spassky archive, Soviet Championship. Rh6 was played and the game ended there. The delaying defence and finish are verified analysis.

reviews.reason: Black mates from an essentially even middlegame by capturing successive interpositions while the stationary rook seals the king’s escape.
reviews.distinctness: Two distinct white rooks can interpose on the first rank. If the farther one interposes first, both must be taken.
reviews.solutionVi: Ván đấu ghi đến Rc1+. Trong phương án phân tích, nếu Trắng chắn bằng Rd1, Đen chơi Rxd1+ Re1 Rxe1#. Xe a2 giữ ô g2 nên Vua Trắng không thoát được.
hintsVi: Xe a2 khống chế ô g2. Hãy tìm nước chiếu của Xe còn lại trên hàng 1.
Tính cả hai cách Trắng dùng Xe chắn đường chiếu.

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: The a2 rook controls g2, which is a real king escape without it. The c-file rook gives the checking captures on the first rank.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: All 41 roots reviewed. Rc1+ is the only forced mate within three, and none forces a shorter mate.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: White can interpose Rd1 or Re1. Against Re1 the immediate Rxe1# works. Against Rd1, the second interposition Re1 must also be captured. There is no material concession.
reviewNotes.level: B. Direct rook entry, followed by calculation of successive interpositions on the checking rank.
reviewNotes.provenance: TWIC 1668 complete tournament score with Llaneza Vega titled IM. The position follows 26.exf5 and the game score ends after Rc1+.

reviews.reason: The first rook shuts the g-file and then the third rank while the second rook uses the f-file to bring the king to e2.
reviews.distinctness: Interior mating net around e2 rather than a corner or back-rank mate. The supporting rook changes jobs between the first check and the final position.
reviews.solutionVi: Ván cờ có Rg3+ Kf1 Rf7+. Nhánh phân tích tiếp tục Ke2 Rf2#. Xe g3 giữ hàng 3, chặn hai ô thoát d3 và e3.
hintsVi: Tìm cách đưa Vua Trắng về cột f bằng một nước Xe chiếu.
Khi Vua ở e2, hãy kiểm tra những ô trên hàng 3 mà Xe g3 đã khống chế.

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: The rook on f2 gives mate and the rook on g3 seals d3 and e3. Removing g3 lets the king escape to either square.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: Rg3+ is the only forced mate in three among 40 roots. Starting with Rf2+ permits Kg1 and no mate in the remaining two solver moves.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: Kf1 and then Ke2 are the only legal replies in the certified line. No material is offered or captured.
reviewNotes.level: Exactly three solver moves without a sacrifice. Finding Rf7+ after the first cutoff brings the king onto e2 for the interior mate.
reviewNotes.provenance: IM and GM headers in TWIC 1663 for the 46th Olympiad. Full replay matches ply 83 after Kg2. The first three plies were played, with Ke2 Rf2# added as analysis.

reviews.reason: The bishop check pushes the king to the corner only because the g-file rook protects the bishop. The second rook clears the h-file with tempo.
reviews.distinctness: A rook protects the preparatory bishop and later stops the king from taking it, while the other rook captures a blocking rook.
reviews.solutionVi: Ván đấu ghi đến Bg8+. Phương án phân tích tiếp tục Kh8 Rxh6+ Rh7 Rxh7#. Xe g1 bảo vệ Tượng g8, nên Vua Đen không thể bắt Tượng để thoát khi Xe h7 chiếu.
hintsVi: Xe g1 bảo vệ ô nào ở cuối cột g?
Khi Vua Đen bị dồn về h8, xem Xe a6 có thể mở cột h bằng nước bắt nào.

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: Rh7 gives mate along the h-file. Without Rg1 the king can capture Bg8. Rg1 also prevents taking the bishop immediately after Bg8+.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: The immediate Rxh6+ has no mate inside three. Neither quiet bishop move shown by the engine nor any other root matches the objective.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: Kh8 and Rh7 are the only replies. Bg8 is protected, and the successive captures on h6 and h7 cost the solver no piece.
reviewNotes.level: B: three solver moves are required against the legal replies, with short preparation or coordination and no sacrifice.
reviewNotes.provenance: Titled Tue 30th Jun 2026, 2026.06.30, round 5. Replayed the complete indexed game to ply 80 and checked the preceding Nf4. Preserved the original game and the archive checksum (https://www.pgnmentor.com/players/Aronian.zip). The analysis continuation differs from the original recorded game.

reviews.reason: Direct mate in an active rook ending with the opposing king in the centre. One rook must stay where it can support the checking rook and cover the king’s exit.
reviews.distinctness: Central king cage on the c-file with support across the sixth rank, distinct from the typical back-rank patterns.
reviews.solutionVi: Rhd6# — Xe từ h6 đến d6 chiếu hết. Xe c6 bảo vệ Xe d6 và khống chế các ô c5, c4.
hintsVi: Một Xe phải giữ cột c. Xe còn lại có thể chiếu Vua Đen từ ô nào?
Kiểm tra cả khả năng Vua Đen bắt Xe chiếu lẫn đường thoát qua c5.

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: The c6 rook guards d6 and denies c5 and c4. Its removal allows Kxd6 and the two c-file escapes.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: All 27 roots reviewed. Rhd6# is the only immediate mate, and moving the c6 rook would release its defensive duties.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: No legal defence remains after Rhd6#. Material is unchanged.
reviewNotes.level: A. Direct recognition of a short-range rook cage in a materially contested ending.
reviewNotes.provenance: TWIC 1666 complete team rapid game with IM Martins. Kd5 is the preceding recorded move and Rhd6# is the actual finish.

reviews.reason: The first rook drives the king onto the h-file and shuts the g-file while the other rook mates across the third rank.
reviews.distinctness: A direct two-check net on the side of the board. The file cutoff stops both retreats to g2 and g4.
reviews.solutionVi: Phương án phân tích: Rg1+ đẩy Vua Trắng sang h3. Sau Rf3#, Xe g1 khóa cột g nên Vua không thể thoát qua g2 hoặc g4.
hintsVi: Tìm nước chiếu khiến Vua Trắng phải rời cột g.

reviews.solutionVi: Trong ván đấu, Đen chơi Rxd7. Phương án chiếu hết là Re2+. Sau Kg1 hoặc Kh1, Đen đều chơi Rc1#. Xe e2 khóa đường trở lại hàng 2.
hintsVi: Hãy dùng một Xe chiếu ngang để dồn Vua Trắng xuống hàng 1.
Kiểm tra cả Kg1 và Kh1. Xe còn lại có thể chiếu từ cùng một ô.

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: Without the rook on e2, the white king can escape to h2, g2 or f2. The rook on c1 supplies the rank check.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: All 28 roots reviewed. Only Re2+ forces mate in two. The played Rxd7 wins material but does not force the same mate.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: The exact replies Kg1 and Kh1 are both covered by Rc1#. Material is unchanged.
reviewNotes.level: A. One forcing check with two replies and a common direct finish.
reviewNotes.provenance: Checksummed Karpov PGN Mentor archive. The recorded final move Rxd7 differs from the exercise and is explicitly identified.

reviews.reason: The back rook f8 protects the front rook on f7 and covers g8 and h8.
reviews.distinctness: The learner must select the correct rook on a shared file, unlike a simple one-rook approach.
reviews.solutionVi: R1f7# đưa Xe từ f1 lên f7. Xe f8 bảo vệ f7 và khóa g8, h8, nên Vua Đen không thể bắt Xe chiếu hoặc lùi về hàng 8.
hintsVi: Hai Xe cùng đứng trên cột f. Hãy chọn Xe có thể đến f7 mà vẫn giữ được ô f8.
Kiểm tra xem Xe còn lại chặn những ô thoát nào trên hàng 8.

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: The back rook f8 protects the front rook on f7 and covers g8 and h8.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: Only R1f7# mates immediately. Moving the f8 rook gives up the protection behind the checking rook.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: The f8 rook rules out Kxf7, Kg8 and Kh8. The finished board has no legal defensive move.
reviewNotes.level: One direct solver move with a SAN disambiguation that matters to the teaching point.
reviewNotes.provenance: World Blitz game in PGN Mentor, ending in played R1f7# after ...Kxg7.

reviews.reason: Direct edge-file mate with the other rook denying a first-rank escape. The check is safe because a queen guards the landing square.
reviews.distinctness: The checking rook descends the h-file, the queen guards the rook, and the second rook alone seals g1 and f1. Different division of roles from the doubled h-file cases.
reviews.solutionVi: Rh2# — Xe từ h8 đến h2 chiếu hết. Hậu f4 bảo vệ Xe h2, còn Xe d1 khóa các ô g1 và f1.
hintsVi: Xe d1 giữ hàng 1. Xe h8 có thể chiếu Vua Trắng từ ô nào?
Kiểm tra quân nào bảo vệ Xe khi Xe đến h2.

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: Removing the d1 rook allows Kg1 or Kf1. The queen on f4 protects the checking rook on h2 along f4–g3–h2.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: All 49 roots reviewed. Only Rh2# mates immediately.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: White has no legal reply after the rook reaches the queen-guarded square. No sacrifice is involved.
reviewNotes.level: A. One direct move that requires recognizing both the edge check and the first-rank barrier.
reviewNotes.provenance: Complete recorded master-game score and a checksummed source are in the packet. The preceding Nxd4 and the played Rh2# match.

reviews.reason: The only mate in two is a genuine queen sacrifice that draws the king onto the a-file while the stationary b4 rook seals both flights.
reviews.distinctness: The queen draws the defending king itself to a2. The checking rook must then capture the a5 pawn, while the second rook covers b2 and b3. In Shohradova–Atalik the sacrifice instead deflects the defending queen and leads to an interposition.
reviews.solutionVi: Trong ván đấu, Đen chơi Nc3. Phương án phân tích là Qxa2+ Kxa2 Rxa5#. Đen thí Hậu để kéo Vua Trắng lên a2. Xe a8 bắt Tốt a5 để chiếu dọc cột a. Xe b4 khống chế b2 và b3.
hintsVi: Vua Trắng ở a1. Xe b4 đang khống chế những ô thoát nào nếu Vua lên a2?
Tìm nước thí Hậu đưa Vua lên cột a, rồi xét cách loại bỏ Tốt a5.

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: At Rxa5#, the a5 rook gives the file check and the b4 rook removes the king flights b2 and b3. Either rook is essential.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: Compared all 52 legal roots. Qxa2+ is the only mate within two. Neither an immediate mate nor an equally short non-sacrificial or non-two-rook strategy exists. The recorded Nc3 does not mate within two.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: After Qxa2+ the only legal answer is Kxa2. Black gives a queen for two pawns in the full line, a net 700 cp concession, and the lost queen cannot be recovered by exchange. Both rooks remain through mate.
reviewNotes.level: C. Black starts only 120 cp ahead, with major pieces and active material for both sides. One clear queen sacrifice, in two solver turns, changes the position to forced mate.
reviewNotes.provenance: Complete PGN Mentor Korchnoi archive replay, Quebec Open 2004. Verified exact ply after Rb1 and archived credential. The recorded next move is Nc3, so the entire mating continuation is analysis.

reviews.reason: The queen sacrifice is the only mate in two from a materially inferior position. If White accepts, the pawn leaves g2 and the h8 rook takes over on h3, supported by the other rook.
reviews.distinctness: The accepting defence is a pawn capture that opens a mating square on the h-file while vacating g2. The declining king move lets the queen finish on g2. This differs from the king and queen captures elsewhere in the batch and from the g-file clearance with a bishop interposition in Gruzman–Carlsen.
reviews.solutionVi: Ván đấu dừng sau Qxh3+. Trong phương án phân tích, nếu Trắng nhận thí Hậu bằng gxh3, Xe h8 xuống h3 chiếu hết bằng Rhxh3#. Xe g3 bảo vệ h3 và khống chế g1, g2. Nếu Vua Trắng chọn Kg1, Đen chiếu hết bằng Qxg2#.
hintsVi: Tìm nước chiếu có thể kéo Tốt g2 sang cột h.
Nếu Trắng bắt Hậu trên h3, hãy chọn Xe có thể chiếu ở h3 mà vẫn giữ Xe g3 tại chỗ.

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: The h8 rook delivers checkmate from h3 after White accepts. The g3 rook guards h3, g1 and g2. Removing it gives Kxh3, Kg1 or Kg2. Removing the h3 rook removes the check. The alternative Kg1 is met by Qxg2# and does not change the necessity of the offer at the root.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: Compared all 36 legal roots. No mate in one or equally quick non-sacrificial mate. Qxh3+ alone forces mate in two. The natural Rxh3+ gives neither mate in one after Kg1 nor mate in one after gxh3.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: Verified the only two legal replies, gxh3 and Kg1, through their terminal checkmates. In the accepting line Black trades a queen for two pawns with no recapture of comparable value, a net concession of 700 cp from the start. Black starts 290 cp down, and a nonforcing move can let White take the queen on h5 or rook on g3.
reviewNotes.level: One genuine queen offer with a clear purpose and two solver moves. The player distinguishes offering the queen on h3 from offering the rook on the same square.
reviewNotes.provenance: Full PGN Mentor Short archive replay reaches the exercise FEN and the preceding Rxf5 exactly. Grischuk–Short, Reykjavik, April 2000. The recorded game ends at Qxh3+, so both continuations are analysis.

reviews.reason: Qxc2+ is the only root that forces mate in three. Its accepting branch has a genuine queen concession and requires both rooks.
reviews.distinctness: The sacrifice captures a rook and deflects the other queen from a4 to c2. The defending queen must then return to a4 as a blocker in the published line. Compare the simpler direct king lure in Hebert–Korchnoi.
reviews.solutionVi: Trong ván đấu, Đen chơi Qe6+. Phương án phân tích bắt đầu bằng Qxc2+. Nếu Trắng nhận thí Hậu bằng Qxc2, Đen chiếu Ra7+. Hậu Trắng phải che ở a4 và Đen chơi Rxa4#. Xe b6 khóa b1, b2 và b3. Nếu Trắng chọn Ka1 ngay sau Qxc2+, Đen chiếu hết ngay bằng Qa4#.
hintsVi: Xe b6 khóa cột b. Quân Trắng nào đang cản đường chiếu dọc cột a?
Tìm nước thí Hậu để kéo Hậu Trắng rời a4. Sau đó, tính cách bắt quân che đường chiếu.

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: In the accepting Qxc2 branch, Ra7+ forces Qa4 and Rxa4# gives the file check. The b6 rook removes Kb1, Kb2 and Kb3. Declining on Ka1 leads to a queen mate, but it is not a substitute against the accepting defence.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: Compared all 41 legal roots. Only Qxc2+ forces mate within three, and there is no mate in two. The exact root test ruled out any equally short sacrifice-free or wholly non-two-rook strategy. The recorded Qe6+ does not achieve mate within three.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: Checked every legal reply Qxc2, Ka3 and Ka1. Qxc2 wins Black’s queen for a rook, conceding 400 cp through Ra7+. The opposing queen is only recovered after its forced Qa4 interposition, at the point of mate. Ka3 Qxa4+ Kxa4 Ra7# is an alternative exchange after the declined offer. Ka1 Qc3+ Ka2 Qb2# is a separate mate against refusal. No additional sacrifice is necessary.
reviewNotes.level: C. Black starts a minor piece ahead, but White still has two rooks and an active queen. A single unequal queen-for-rook offer is required against the accepting defence. The full line is three solver turns.
reviewNotes.provenance: TWIC 1664 complete Women’s Olympiad game, WFM Shohradova versus IM Atalik. Verified exact ply after Rc2. Qe6+ was the recorded next move, so all mating lines shown are analysis.

reviews.reason: The bishop sacrifice clears the f-file and forces the defender to choose between taking with the rook or king. Against the rook capture, one rook checks on f8 and the other keeps the g7 pawn safe.
reviews.distinctness: A minor-piece clearance removes the bishop from f5 and draws the defending rook from h6. The supporting rook guards a pawn the king could otherwise capture. The king-capture defence instead allows promotion mate, unlike the pawn-deflection or queen-deflection branches elsewhere in this batch.
reviews.solutionVi: Trong ván đấu, Trắng đi Be4. Phương án phân tích bắt đầu bằng Bh7+, thí Tượng để mở cột f. Nếu Đen bắt bằng Rxh7, Trắng chơi Rf8#. Xe g3 bảo vệ Tốt g7 nên Vua Đen không thể bắt Tốt để thoát. Nếu Đen chọn Kxh7, Trắng phong Hậu và chiếu hết bằng g8=Q#.
hintsVi: Tượng f5 đang chắn đường Xe f1 lên f8. Tìm nước Tượng chiếu để mở cột f.
Sau khi Tượng đến h7, hãy tính riêng hai cách Đen bắt Tượng, bằng Xe hoặc bằng Vua.

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: In the selected Rxh7 branch, the f8 rook gives checkmate while the g3 rook protects the g7 pawn. Removing g3 allows Kxg7. Removing f8 removes the check. Kxh7 allows a different finish, g8=Q#, but cannot bypass the bishop offer.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: Compared all 36 legal roots. Bh7+ alone forces mate within two solver moves and no equally quick non-sacrificial route exists. The bishop on f5 makes Rf8+ illegal in the starting position. Be6+ is not an equally short mate.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: Replayed both legal replies to Bh7+. Rxh7 leaves Black in a two-rook mate after Rf8# with no recovery of the bishop, a 330 cp concession. Kxh7 instead allows immediate promotion mate after accepting the same bishop offer. Material starts near equal at +30 cp and Qxg7, Qxf5 or Qxg3+ shows active counterplay if White fails to force the issue.
reviewNotes.level: One purposeful bishop sacrifice followed by immediate mate after either capture. The accepting rook reply gives the intended two-rook finish in two solver moves.
reviewNotes.provenance: Full TWIC 1656 Bacrot–Maghsoodloo game replay and preceding Rh6 verified against the archived source. Both are recorded as GMs. The game continued Be4 Rf6 Bd5+ Qxd5 cxd5; the proposed mate is analysis from the recorded position.

reviews.reason: A quiet bishop move cuts d8. Black has 21 replies, and only Ra7 stops an immediate mate by threatening to capture the rook that would land on e7. White must find a rook capture before the two-rook finish.
reviews.distinctness: A bishop closes a flight square before the solver deals with a lateral rook defence. The threatened checking rook must first capture on a7, then return along the seventh rank to e7.
reviews.solutionVi: Ván đấu dừng sau Bb6, nước khóa ô d8. Trong phương án phân tích, Đen đáp Ra7 để có thể bắt Xe nếu Trắng chiếu Rbe7+. Trắng cần chơi Rxa7 trước. Sau Nxf2, Rae7# chiếu hết. Xe f7 bảo vệ e7 và khống chế f8.
hintsVi: Nếu chiếu ngay Rbe7+, Vua Đen có thể thoát qua d8. Tìm cách khống chế ô đó.
Khi Xe Đen đến a7, hãy kiểm tra xem nó có thể bắt Xe chiếu trên e7 hay không.

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: After Rxa7 Nxf2 Rae7#, the e7 rook checks and the f7 rook covers f8 and protects e7. Removing the f7 rook permits Kf8 and Kxe7. All certified lines retain both-rook necessity.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: Replayed all 34 roots. Bb6 alone forces mate within three solver moves. Immediate Rbe7+ lets the king reach d8. After Bb6 Ra7, Rbe7+ fails to Rxe7 and only Rxa7 forces mate in the two remaining moves.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: Verified all 21 replies to Bb6 and every reply after Rxa7. Other root defences allow mate in one, including Nxf2 Rbe7#. Nxf2 was available before Bb6 as a legal remote pawn capture and does not take a moved or supporting piece. In the main line White captures a rook and stays ahead by 400 cp relative to the start after the pawn capture. After Rxa7 Rf8 either rook can legally mate on e7.
reviewNotes.level: A quiet move controls a flight square, but the defender’s lateral rook move uniquely stops immediate mate and changes the solver’s move to Rxa7. Exactly three solver moves against Ra7, with no sacrifice.
reviewNotes.provenance: Full replay reaches the recorded source ply and the previous move Ke8 exactly. TWIC 1664, 46th Olympiad, Camacho Collados–Mak, with a recorded IM title. The game ends with Bb6, so all subsequent moves are analysis.

reviews.reason: The king must first cover d7 and e7, and Black has two different interpositions that demand different rook checks.
reviews.distinctness: Quiet king preparation followed by a choice between files depending on the opponent’s rook or bishop defence.
reviews.solutionVi: Ván đấu dừng sau Ke6. Vua Trắng giữ d7 và bảo vệ e7. Trong phương án phân tích, nếu Đen chơi Rh1, Xe Đen có thể bắt Xe khi Trắng chiếu Rh8+ ngay. Trắng đổi hướng bằng Re7+ Kd8 Rf8#. Xe e7 khóa ô c7. Nếu Đen chơi Bc5, Trắng lại chọn Rh8+ Bf8 Rhxf8#.
hintsVi: Vua Trắng cần giữ thêm ô nào trước khi hai Xe chiếu?
Nếu Xe Đen sang h1, hãy đổi hướng chiếu. Nếu Đen đưa Tượng tới c5, tính cách xử lý khi Tượng chắn ở f8.

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: Ke6 covers d7 and protects the supporting rook on e7. After Rh1 Re7+ Kd8 Rf8#, e7 guards c7, which would otherwise be a legal escape.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: All 33 legal starts compared. Only Ke6 mates within three; immediate Rh8+ allows Ke7 or Kd7. After Ke6 Rh1, Rh8+ is captured by Rxh8 and premature Rf8+ by Kxf8, leaving Re7+ as the only two-turn answer.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: All 29 first replies checked. Rh1 and Bc5 are equally deep but demand Re7+ and Rh8+ respectively. After Bc5 Rh8+ Bf8 the solver captures the blocking bishop. Bxf2 is a pre-existing pawn capture unrelated to the mating action. Shortcuts against inferior replies do not bypass both rooks against the two strong replies.
reviewNotes.level: C* because the quiet king move is necessary, two qualitatively distinct strong defences keep mate three moves deep, and no voluntary material concession occurs.
reviewNotes.provenance: Complete Karpov PGN Mentor archive record, Cap d’Agde, with indexed master credential. Last two recorded moves are Ke8 and Ke6. Both shown defences and finishes are analysis.

reviews.reason: Quiet Bf3 protects the exposed g4 rook, and the defender’s unique Ng6 resource prepares a counterchecking interposition that forces the correct rook capture on h4.
reviews.distinctness: The solver must first protect a rook from a king capture and then choose which rook takes a knight that both blocks check and gives countercheck. The other rook must remain on g4.
reviews.solutionVi: Ván đấu dừng sau Bf3, nước bảo vệ Xe g4. Trong phương án phân tích, Đen đáp Ng6 để chuẩn bị chắn chiếu. Sau Rh1+ Nh4+, Trắng dùng Xe h1 bắt Mã bằng Rhxh4#. Xe g4 giữ hai ô thoát g5 và g6. Nếu dùng Xe g4 bắt Mã, Vua Đen còn đường thoát.
hintsVi: Nếu chiếu ngay Rh1+, Vua Đen có thể bắt Xe g4. Hãy tìm cách bảo vệ Xe này trước.
Nếu Mã Đen đến h4 vừa chắn chiếu vừa chiếu lại, hãy chọn Xe bắt Mã sao cho vẫn giữ được cột g.

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: The h4 rook delivers mate and the g4 rook shuts g5 and g6. The tempting Rgxh4+ allows both Kg5 and Kg6. Every certified terminal line needs both rooks.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: Replayed all 43 roots. Bf3 alone forces mate within three solver moves. Immediate Rh1+ allows Kxg4. After Bf3 Ng6, only Rh1+ keeps mate within the two remaining moves.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: Verified all 21 replies to Bf3. Only Ng6 prevents immediate Rh1#, and the sole reply to Rh1+ on this branch is the countercheck Nh4+. Rhxh4# captures the knight without a sacrifice. The remote pawn capture cxd4 already existed before Bf3 and allows Rh1# immediately, with no effect on the attack.
reviewNotes.level: Three solver moves are necessary against Ng6, and the later countercheck requires choosing the correct rook when both can capture h4. Other defences allow a shorter mate.
reviewNotes.provenance: Complete Kramnik archive replay and preceding Kh5 verified. Tal Memorial Blitz 2016, Svidler–Kramnik, stops after Bf3. The continuation is analysis.

reviews.reason: The rook capture opens a mating attack, but moving the b1 rook creates an escape and makes the solver drive the king there before mating with support from a8.
reviews.distinctness: A defensive retreat opens a king flight square in an otherwise trapped corner. Capturing the attacking rook actually permits immediate mate.
reviews.solutionVi: Ván đấu dừng sau Rxa4. Trong phương án phân tích, Rbd1 mở ô b1 cho Vua Trắng. Đen bắt Hậu bằng Rxa2+ để đẩy Vua tới b1, rồi chiếu hết bằng Ra1#. Xe a8 bảo vệ Xe a1. Nếu Trắng bắt Xe bằng Qxa4, Xe a8 bắt lại và chiếu hết ngay bằng Rxa4#.
hintsVi: Tìm cách bắt Mã a4 và khai thác cột a đang bị chặn bởi Hậu Trắng.
Nếu Xe b1 rời vị trí, Vua Trắng thoát tới ô nào? Hãy giữ Xe a8 để bảo vệ nước chiếu cuối.

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: After Rbd1 Rxa2+ Kb1 Ra1#, the checking rook on a1 is protected by a8. Removing the rear rook admits Kxa1.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: All 42 legal starting moves compared. Rxa4 is the only mate within three, with no mate in two. After Rbd1 or Rbc1 the only two-turn solver continuation starts with Rxa2+.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: All 24 first replies checked. Rbd1 and Rbc1 vacate b1, preserving a king flight against Rxa2+. Qxa4 is an immediate exchange: the other rook takes the queen and mates, for a queen and knight against a rook. Rxe6 or fxe6 trades queens after the knight gain and allows immediate Rxa2#. There is no genuine offer.
reviewNotes.level: C* because the hardest defensive retreat is quiet, saves the immediate mate by making a new escape square, and forces a two-move continuation with both rooks after it.
reviewNotes.provenance: Complete PGN Mentor Spassky archive game from Linares 1983 with indexed master credential. Exact previous exf5 is preserved. Rxa4 was played and the rest is analysis.

reviews.reason: The direct, unique rook mate boxes in a central king by preserving the lower rank barrier.
reviews.distinctness: The rooks begin on one file but attack across two different ranks. Picking the wrong rook gives three escapes rather than merely leaving the checking rook undefended.
reviews.solutionVi: Đen chiếu hết bằng R8a3#. Xe a8 xuống a3 chiếu ngang vào Vua d3. Xe a2 giữ c2, d2 và e2. Nếu dùng Xe a2 để chiếu, Vua Trắng có thể thoát xuống hàng 2.
hintsVi: Vua Trắng ở d3. Xe a2 đang chặn các ô thoát nào ngay bên dưới Vua?
Giữ Xe ở a2 và tìm nước chiếu ngang bằng Xe còn lại.

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: Ra3 supplies the check and the a2 rook denies Kc2, Kd2 and Ke2. The motif fails without either rook.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: R8a3# is the only mate among 29 legal roots. R2a3+ permits Kc2, Kd2 or Ke2.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: The one-move proof has no legal reply or recapture. The check gives up no material.
reviewNotes.level: One direct check with an obvious rank barrier, suitable for A.
reviewNotes.provenance: Replayed the complete PGN Mentor Carlsen archive game. Kd3 reaches the exact source frame at ply 73, and R8a3# is the recorded final move.

reviews.reason: Direct capture of the piece that has just blocked check. The stationary rook shuts the surviving flight square and the knight protects the checking rook.
reviews.distinctness: Black to move, capture of the defending rook on e3 after an interposition. A knight guards the checking rook while the second rook restricts a flight on the adjacent file. Unlike a standard ladder mate, the king is in the middle of the board.
reviews.solutionVi: Rxe3# — Xe từ e2 đến e3, bắt Xe Trắng và chiếu hết. Mã c4 bảo vệ Xe e3, còn Xe f5 chặn ô thoát f4.
hintsVi: Trắng vừa dùng Xe che đường chiếu. Hãy xem Đen có thể bắt Xe đó bằng nước chiếu nào.
Vua Trắng có thể bắt Xe ở e3 hoặc thoát qua f4 không?

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: The e2-rook captures on e3 and checks along the e-file. Removing the f5-rook opens Kf4. The c4-knight guards e3 against Kxe3.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: All 37 legal roots checked. Rxe3# alone mates immediately. Re5+ allows Kf4, Kf3, Kd3 or dxe5; Rf4+ lets White take the f4-rook or play Kd3. Both knight checks also let the king escape.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: No legal replies to Rxe3#. This is a capture that wins the rook on e3 and ends in mate, with no material offered.
reviewNotes.level: One direct capture and mate, no preparatory move or sacrifice.
reviewNotes.provenance: Replayed the complete Titled Tuesday game, Timmermans–Carlsen, 23 May 2023. After 40.Re3, 40...Rxe3# is the played finish. Verified source ply 79, preceding FEN, original PGN Mentor checksum and archive player identity.

reviews.reason: The rook mates at a distance because the second rook closes the adjacent rank and opposing pieces occupy the other flights.
reviews.distinctness: Long-range e-file check from e8 against a king on e6. The support rook works across the seventh rank rather than guarding the checking rook or being doubled on the same file. The apparent closer check, Re7+, loses the checking rook.
reviews.solutionVi: Re8# — Xe từ b8 đến e8, chiếu hết. Xe g7 khóa d7 và f7. Xe d6 và Tốt f6 của Đen cũng chắn đường Vua Đen thoát sang hai bên.
hintsVi: Vua Đen ở e6. Xe g7 đã khống chế những ô nào trên hàng 7?
Giữ Xe g7 và tìm nước chiếu dọc cột e bằng Xe còn lại.

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: The b8-rook checks down the e-file. Removing the g7-rook opens Kd7 and Kf7. Black’s rook d6 and pawn f6 occupy adjacent flights.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: All 26 legal roots checked. Re8# is the only mate in one. The other check, Re7+, allows Kxe7.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: No legal replies after mate, including blocking the e-file or taking the checking rook. No sacrifice or material loss.
reviewNotes.level: Direct one-move application of complementary rook lines.
reviewNotes.provenance: Replayed the complete 2024 World Blitz game, Niemann–Carlsen, New York, 31 December. 41.Re8# is the recorded finish after 40...Rd6. Verified source ply 80, preceding FEN and PGN Mentor archive/checksum.

reviews.reason: Both rooks can deliver the same contact mate, provided the other stays to protect the destination square.
reviews.distinctness: Reciprocal rook support in a central mating net. Unlike wrong-rook exercises, choosing either rook really does mate. The copy explicitly recognizes both legal solutions.
reviews.solutionVi: Trong ván đấu, Trắng chơi R7d5# bằng Xe d7. Xe d1 bảo vệ d5 nên Vua Đen không thể bắt Xe chiếu. R1d5# cũng chiếu hết vì khi đó Xe d7 bảo vệ d5.
hintsVi: Vua Đen có thể bắt Xe trên d5 nếu ô đó không được bảo vệ. Hãy xét vai trò của Xe còn lại.
Thử cả hai cách đưa Xe đến d5. Xe đứng yên có bảo vệ được ô chiếu không?

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: Both R7d5# and R1d5# need the stationary rook to defend d5. Removing that rook permits Kxd5 in either branch.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: The exact 49-root comparison found two mates, R7d5# and R1d5#. Neither bypasses the rook pair.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: Both mates have no legal reply. Neither captures, trades or offers material.
reviewNotes.level: One immediate checkmate with a simple reciprocal protection relationship, suitable for A.
reviewNotes.provenance: Replayed the complete PGN Mentor Shirov archive game. Qb6 reaches ply 62. R7d5# is the recorded finish and R1d5# is a verified alternative.

reviews.reason: A direct double check by bishop and rook forces a single king move. The two rooks already occupy their required lanes for the next move.
reviews.distinctness: The bishop opens the d-file and adds its own check at the same time, preventing blocks or captures available after ordinary discovered checks. The stationary rook on f2 cuts off the last flight square once the other rook checks along the first rank.
reviews.solutionVi: Bg4+ — Tượng từ d7 đến g4, vừa chiếu Vua vừa mở cột d cho Xe d8 cùng chiếu. Trắng chỉ có Kc1. Đen tiếp tục Rd1#, với Tượng g4 bảo vệ Xe d1 và Xe f2 chặn ô c2.
hintsVi: Tượng d7 đang chắn đường Xe d8. Hãy tìm nước Tượng đi để cả Tượng và Xe cùng chiếu Vua Trắng.
Sau khi Vua Trắng tới c1, Xe f2 khóa ô thoát nào? Hãy tìm nước chiếu hết bằng Xe còn lại.

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: The d8-rook and g4-bishop give double check on the first move. At the finish, the d1-rook checks and the bishop protects it. Removing the f2-rook opens Kc2.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: All 39 legal roots checked, with no mate in one. Only Bg4+ mates in two. Be8+, Bf5+ and Bh3+ allow multiple extra replies, including Rxd8; Rd2+ allows Kxd2.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: Kc1 is the only legal answer to the double check, and Rd1# has no legal reply. Neither the bishop nor either rook is sacrificed; material stays level with the start.
reviewNotes.level: One forcing preparatory check and a direct rook mate. A single defensive move and no sacrifice keep it appropriate for Level A.
reviewNotes.provenance: Replayed the complete Winants–Kortschnoj game from SWIFT, Brussels, 1986. After 31.Ra8, all three sample plies 31...Bg4+ 32.Kc1 Rd1# were played. Verified source ply 61, preceding FEN and PGN Mentor Korchnoi archive checksum. The source records the year only.

reviews.reason: The initial rook check places the king on the g-file while preserving the h-file barrier needed by the finishing rook.
reviews.distinctness: Two-move rook handoff with a capture on a different file. The early capture does not check, so the learner must first move the king and retain control of its retreats.
reviews.solutionVi: Trắng chơi Rh2+ để buộc Vua Đen sang g6. Sau Kg6, Rxg4# chiếu hết. Xe h2 chặn h5 và bảo vệ Tốt h6 nên Vua Đen không thể thoát sang cột h. Nếu bắt Tốt g4 ngay, Trắng chưa chiếu được Vua.
hintsVi: Trước khi bắt Tốt g4, hãy tìm nước chiếu đưa Vua Đen sang cột g.
Sau khi Vua sang g6, một Xe giữ cột h. Xe còn lại có thể bắt Tốt nào để chiếu hết?

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: Rg4 gives the final file check. Rh2 controls h5 and protects h6, which otherwise admits Kxh6.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: No mate in one exists among 30 legal roots. Only Rh2+ forces mate in two. Rxg4 first is not check and allows the king to escape or take.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: Kg6 is the only legal reply to Rh2+. Rxg4# captures the g4 pawn and allows no legal reply. No material is offered within the exercise.
reviewNotes.level: Two direct checks, one forced king move and no sacrifice. The exercise begins after Kxh5, suitable for A.
reviewNotes.provenance: Replayed the complete PGN Mentor Carlsen archive game. Kxh5 reaches ply 62 and all three SAN moves match the recorded game finish.

reviews.reason: A balanced White-to-move position with a clear three-check plan. The rook from a8 drives the king to the corner and the rook from b5 delivers mate.
reviews.distinctness: The rook travels a8–a7–b7 to drive the king back to a8. Its partner then mates from a5 along the edge file. The last rook move changes the direction of the check. Prefer this to pairing it with 4cdea2f7, which also uses two checks by one rook and a finishing check by the other.
reviews.solutionVi: Trong ván đấu, Trắng chơi 33.Rxc5+ và ván đấu kết thúc ở nước đó. Phương án phân tích là 33.Ra7+ Kb8 34.Rb7+ Ka8 35.Ra5#. Xe đi từ a8 qua a7 đến b7 và giữ ô b8. Xe còn lại từ b5 sang a5 chiếu hết dọc cột a.
hintsVi: Dùng Xe a8 để buộc Vua Đen rời c7. Xe này có thể tiếp tục chiếu ngang từ hàng 7.
Khi Vua Đen về góc a8, giữ ô b8 và tìm nước chiếu dọc cột a bằng Xe còn lại.

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: The rook on b7 stops Kb8 and the rook on a5 supplies the a-file check. Removing either rook breaks mate. Ra7+ cannot force a mate in three without the two-rook pattern.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: Of 30 legal roots, only Ra7+ forces mate within three solver moves. No root mates in one or two. The played Rxc5+ is among the roots that do not force the exercise goal in three.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: After Ra7+ only Kb8 is legal, and after Rb7+ only Ka8 is legal. Neither check permits a capture of either rook, and the variation contains no captures or material concession.
reviewNotes.level: Exactly three moves by White. The first two checks force unique king replies, making the short rook coordination appropriate for B.
reviewNotes.provenance: Replayed the complete Shirov–Brynell game from the checksummed Shirov PGN archive. The FEN follows 32...Kc7 and the recorded score ends after 33.Rxc5+. The mate is labeled as analysis.

reviews.reason: The quiet h3 protects the rook that cuts off the second rank. White has a single countercheck that postpones the same rook mate.
reviews.distinctness: A pawn move prepares the final rook transfer by protecting the rook that stays put. This differs from starts that drive the king immediately with check.
reviews.solutionVi: Ván đấu dừng sau h3. Tốt h3 bảo vệ Xe g2 để Xe h2 có thể xuống h1 chiếu hết. Trong phương án phân tích, Trắng có thể kéo dài bằng Rxg7+. Đen đáp Kxg7, rồi chiếu hết bằng Rh1# sau Ke1. Nếu chiếu Rh1+ ngay từ thế ban đầu, Vua Trắng có thể bắt Xe g2.
hintsVi: Nếu Xe h2 đi xuống h1 ngay, quân nào của Đen có thể bị Vua Trắng bắt?
Dùng Tốt bảo vệ Xe g2, rồi tính cách đáp lại nước chiếu bằng Xe của Trắng.

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: Rh1 checks on the first rank. Rg2 removes Kf2, Ke2 and Kd2 in the sample. The h3 pawn guards the stationary Rg2 once Rh2 leaves.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: All 18 roots compared. Direct Rh1+ allows Kxg2. Only h3 forces mate within three and no root forces mate in fewer moves.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: Rxg7+ is the sole reply delaying mate. Kxg7 recaptures the rook for the pawn, a gain of 400 cp. Every legal branch was replayed. After the sample Ke1, Rg1# is also legal, with the rooks changing roles.
reviewNotes.level: One quiet protective pawn move prepares a direct rook mate. The only forcing defence is the readily answered Rxg7+.
reviewNotes.provenance: The full Korchnoi archive game matches the exact frame after Kf1. The game ended after the played h3. The subsequent moves are analysis.

reviews.reason: The f4 rook takes f2 and then cuts off the first rank; the rear rook uses the vacated square to mate. The full recorded line is in the all-reply proof.
reviews.distinctness: Same-file rook handoff with two legal king replies to each check and the same finish against all four paths. In the Shirov–Brynell comparison the first rook instead switches files to seal the corner, and the two king replies are individually forced.
reviews.solutionVi: Trong ván đấu, Đen chơi Rxf2+ Kg1 Rf1+ Kg2 R8f2#. Xe f1 giữ g1, h1 và bảo vệ Xe f2. Nếu Vua Trắng đi Kh1 thay cho Kg1, hoặc Kh2 thay cho Kg2, Đen vẫn dùng cùng hai nước Xe để chiếu hết.
hintsVi: Tìm nước bắt Tốt f2 có chiếu để đưa Vua Trắng xuống hàng 1.
Đưa Xe vừa bắt Tốt xuống f1. Xe nào sẽ chiếu trên f2 khi Vua Trắng trở lại hàng 2?

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: The checking rook arrives from f8 and the f1 rook shuts off the first rank. Removing either rook eliminates the mate in the recorded finish.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: The exact comparison covers all 25 starting moves. Only Rxf2+ forces mate within three, and no start forces mate sooner or bypasses the rook motif.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: After Rxf2+, Kg1 and Kh1 both meet Rf1+. After either, Kg2 and Kh2 both meet R8f2#. There are no defensive captures on this tree. Black gains the f2 pawn and makes no material offer.
reviewNotes.level: Three solver turns. The learner uses a direct capture to gain a tempo and makes one short supporting move before the final check, which fits B.
reviewNotes.provenance: Verified the full archived Carlsen game, the exact source ply and previous move, and the complete actual finish through R8f2#.

deferred.reason: Keep as a reserve for cột h interposition. The selected Kramnik–Ljubojevic and Sherbakov–Spassky games cover different edge preparations and stronger distinct defensive responses.
deferred.distinctness: File cutoff before the chase, followed by capture of an interposing rook. Three different king squares lead to the same finish.

hintsVi: Xe nào có thể chặn đường Vua chạy về cột g?
Khi Vua đã sang cột h, hãy tính cả cách Đen đưa Xe sang chắn chiếu.

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: The rook on h2 checks and the rook on g8 covers the adjacent g-file. Without the latter, the king can flee to the g-file.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: Rg8+ is the only root with a forced mate in three among 26 moves. The played Rd4 permits Kh6 and other replies; Rh8 permits Kg6.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: Kh6, Kh5 and Kh4 all allow Rh1+ and the only block Rh2 is captured. No solver piece is offered or lost; the finish wins a rook in the process.
reviewNotes.level: Exactly three solver moves and no sacrifice. Cut off the king before switching the other rook to the checking file.
reviewNotes.provenance: Two GM headers in TWIC 1665. Full replay matches ply 72 after Kg5. The sample is an analysis variation; the record plays Rd4.

deferred.reason: Reserve the analogous role switch on the second rank. Duda–Maghsoodloo teaches the same rook handoff from equal material.
deferred.distinctness: Change the checking rook while staying on the second rank. The first rook takes h2 and then locks h1.
deferred.solutionVi: Trong ván đấu, Đen chơi ...Rg2+. Phương án chiếu hết tiếp tục với Kh1 Rxh2+ Kg1 Rag2#. Xe h2 bảo vệ Xe g2 và chặn đường Vua chạy về h1.
hintsVi: Hai Xe Đen đã đứng trên hàng 2. Tìm nước chiếu có thể đẩy Vua Trắng về góc.
Sau khi Vua về h1, xem Tốt h2 cản đường phối hợp của hai Xe như thế nào.

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: At the mate the g2-rook gives check. Removing Rh2 allows Kxg2 and Kh1.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: Qxg3+ is a mate in four in the engine screen. No legal root achieves mate in two or bypasses both rooks within three.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: Kh1 and Kg1 are the only legal replies to the successive checks. The solver removes h2 and neither rook is offered.
reviewNotes.level: B: three solver moves are required against the legal replies, with short preparation or coordination and no sacrifice.
reviewNotes.provenance: Titled Tue 12th Sep Early, 2023.09.12, round 11. Replayed the complete indexed game to ply 73 and checked the preceding Ne4. Preserved the original game and the archive checksum (https://www.pgnmentor.com/players/Aronian.zip). The analysis continuation differs from the original recorded game.

deferred.reason: Reserve this single rook interposition. Bouchaara–Llaneza Vega covers two distinct interpositions on the first rank.

deferred.solutionVi: Trong phương án phân tích, Rd2+ đẩy Vua về g1 hoặc h1. Sau Rb1+ Rc1 Rxc1#, Xe d2 giữ hàng 2 để Vua Trắng không thoát lên.
hintsVi: Dồn Vua Trắng xuống hàng 1 và giữ Xe còn lại trên hàng 2.
Tính nước bắt Xe nếu Trắng che đường chiếu ở c1.

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: The d2 rook keeps the white king on rank 1. The other rook checks from b1 and captures the rook interposed on c1.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: Rd2+ and the played Rb2+ both force mate in three. Neither is an unrelated motif bypass, and no root forces a shorter mate.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: The mate certificate covers Kg1 and Kh1. Both are met by Rb1+ Rc1 Rxc1#. The defender is captured without an offer.
reviewNotes.level: A lateral check moves the king to the back rank; a second check then forces a blocking rook before the payoff.
reviewNotes.provenance: Kramnik archive records Rb2+ at the source position. The shown Rd2+ is a separate verified analysis branch.

deferred.reason: The only winning two-move root is sound, but Black starts 800 cp ahead and the key move is already a free capture of the opponent’s last rook. Favor more contested A examples.

Verified but marginal for A. White starts 780 cp ahead in a sparse ending, has several other short continuations and did not play the available mate. Prefer less routine, more contested applications of the same direct motif.
Reserve a valid direct mate with the same g7/h7 endpoint as the selected Duda–Maghsoodloo B game.

hintsVi: Hãy tìm nước chiếu bằng Xe trên cột h.
Sau khi Vua Đen sang g8, kiểm tra Xe nào có thể đến g7.

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: The h7 rook guards h8 and protects the g7 checking rook.

reviewNotes.level: A. Two direct checks and only one defensive reply to the first.

deferred.reason: Reserve this sound back-rank mate. Alekseenko–Bluebaum already covers the same two king flights blocked from the adjacent rank.

hintsVi: Vua Đen ở góc h8. Xe e7 đang giữ những ô thoát nào?
Tìm đường đưa Xe còn lại lên hàng 8 để chiếu ngang.

deferred.reason: Reserve this sound black back-rank ladder. The Gelfand–Radjabov and Nijboer–Karpov selections already cover rank restriction with multiple king destinations.

deferred.solutionVi: Ván cờ dừng sau Rb2+. Nhánh phân tích tiếp tục Kc1 Ra1#. Xe b2 khóa ô c2 nên Vua Trắng không thể thoát lên hàng 2.
hintsVi: Nếu chiếu Ra1+ ngay, Vua Trắng có thể bắt Xe. Tìm nước chiếu đưa Vua sang c1 trước.
Sau khi Vua tới c1, hãy kiểm tra ô c2 trước khi chiếu trên hàng 1.

deferred.reason: Reserve the high-material conversion with an advanced c7 pawn. Other selected examples teach the immediate rook interposition with a more contested start.

Nếu Xe Đen che ở g5, hãy kiểm tra nước bắt lại trên chính ô đó.

Reserve this valid side-file mate. Other chosen positions show the same flight-square restriction in the actual played finish.

hintsVi: Xe g6 đang khống chế ô nào cạnh Vua Đen?
Tìm nước Xe chiếu trên ô được Vua Trắng bảo vệ.

deferred.reason: Reserve this position with a large material advantage. The selected capture out of check illustrates a more specific decision before a similar ladder finish.

deferred.reason: Reserve this valid countercheck exercise. White already has a large material advantage, while the selected C* starts are more contested.

deferred.solutionVi: Phương án phân tích bắt đầu bằng Rf8, dọa Rh8#. Đen có thể kéo dài bằng Bxa2+. Sau Kxa2 Kh6, Trắng chơi Rh8#. Xe g3 chặn đường thoát sang cột g. Nếu Đen chọn Bd3, Trắng chiếu Rh8+, rồi bắt Tượng bằng Rxh7# sau Bh7.
hintsVi: Giữ Xe g3 để khóa cột g và chuẩn bị chiếu trên cột h.
Tính cả nước Tượng bắt Tốt a2 có chiếu và nước Tượng tới d3 để che đường chiếu.

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: At Rh8# after Bxa2+ Kxa2 Kh6, h8 delivers the check and g3 prevents Kg7, Kg6 and Kg5. In the separate Bd3 line the rook captures the blocker on h7, with g3 still restricting the g-file.

No rook can be taken in these branches. White starts 770 cp ahead, so prefer sharper balanced examples if several alternatives qualify.

deferred.reason: Reserve this valid g-file interposition exercise. The selected Camacho–Mak interposition and Svidler–Kramnik countercheck, together with a king move and a rook capture, cover a wider range of initial decisions.
deferred.distinctness: An unobtrusive bishop block switches the exercise from a quiet dual threat to a choice between two same-file rook captures.
deferred.solutionVi: Ván đấu dừng sau Bf5. Trong phương án phân tích, Bg5 chặn đường khống chế trên cột g. Nếu Trắng chiếu Rh7+ ngay, Vua Đen thoát về g8. Trắng phải dùng Xe g1 bắt Tượng bằng R1xg5. Sau Rf8, Rh7# chiếu hết vì Xe g5 giữ g8.
hintsVi: Tìm nước Tượng bảo vệ h7. Sau đó, xét cách Đen cắt đường hoạt động của Xe g1.
Nếu Đen đưa Tượng tới g5, hãy chọn Xe bắt Tượng sao cho Xe còn lại vẫn có thể chiếu từ h7.

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: Bf5 protects h7. After Bg5 the lower rook must capture from g1 and stay on the g-file to cover g8, while the upper rook goes to h7 to give mate.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: All 32 starting moves checked. Immediate Rh7+ allows Kxh7 and Rg8+ allows Kh7 or Rxg8. After Bf5 Bg5, premature Rh7+ permits Kg8, while the exact search leaves only R1xg5 as a two-turn mate.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: All 29 replies to Bf5 and replies to R1xg5 were checked. Only Bg5 stretches mate beyond the next solver turn. Rxc3 and Bxa3 were already possible before Bf5 and lead to immediate mate, and neither rook is offered. R1xg5 gains a bishop.
reviewNotes.level: C* for the unique file interposition that forces the correct rook selection and the full three turns without a sacrifice.
reviewNotes.provenance: TWIC 1668 complete Amsterdam Chess Open game against GM Van Wely. Exact source ply follows Kh8; Bf5 was played, and the defence and finish are analysis.

deferred.reason: The proof is sound, but both strong king moves are handled by the same lateral rook check and identical mate. The difference from a routine B ladder is narrow, so prefer positions with distinct blocking or counterchecking defences.
deferred.distinctness: A rook slides from g7 to f7 to prevent Kf2 in the final position. The two strong king retreats both return to g1 after the same check.
deferred.solutionVi: Ván đấu dừng sau Rg7+. Trong phương án phân tích, nếu Vua Đen sang f1 hoặc f2, Trắng chơi Rf7+ Kg1 Re1#. Xe f7 chặn ô f2. Nếu Đen đi Kh1 ngay, Re1# chiếu hết sớm hơn.
hintsVi: Tìm nước chiếu buộc Vua Đen rời ô g1.
Khi Vua Đen sang cột f, hãy tìm cách khóa ô f2 trước khi chiếu trên hàng 1.

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: The f7 rook covers f2 after Re1#, and removing it permits Kf2. The e1 rook checks. Kh1 is a weaker defence that allows immediate Re1# without needing both rooks.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: Replayed all 22 roots. Rg7+ alone forces mate in three. After either Kf1 or Kf2, Rf7+ is the unique next move that preserves the mate in two.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: All three replies covered. Kf1 and Kf2 meet Rf7+ Kg1 Re1#, while Kh1 meets Re1# immediately. No captures or material concessions.
reviewNotes.level: Three solver turns are proven against the f-file retreats, but identical replies after both defensive choices make the learner decision close to routine B coordination.
reviewNotes.provenance: Full Karpov archive replay and preceding Kg1 verified. Karpov–Anand at the Lausanne FIDE knockout final ends with Rg7+. Later moves are analysis.

deferred.reason: Reserve this sound g-file contact mate. Earlier Level A exercises already cover choosing between two rooks on one file while retaining the rear rook. This batch uses more balanced starts for the direct selection.
deferred.distinctness: The lower rook's indispensable job is to deny Kh1, even though the bishop also guards g2. The rook choice is therefore about the retreat square rather than only protecting the checking piece.
deferred.solutionVi: Đen chơi R8g2#, đưa Xe g8 xuống g2 chiếu hết. Xe g1 bảo vệ g2 và khống chế h1. Nếu dùng Xe g1 để chiếu bằng R1g2+, Vua Trắng còn lùi được về h1.
hintsVi: Nếu Xe g1 rời chỗ, Vua Trắng có thể lùi về ô nào?
Chọn Xe có thể đến g2 mà vẫn chặn được đường lùi đó.

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: The checking rook on g2 attacks the adjacent king. Removing g1 allows Kh1 despite the bishop's protection of g2.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: The exact 35-root comparison found only R8g2#. R1g2+ allows the legal Kh1 reply.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: No legal reply follows the played mate. The move does not capture or offer material.
reviewNotes.level: One direct move with a clear choice between doubled rooks, suitable for A.
reviewNotes.provenance: Replayed the complete PGN Mentor Shirov archive game. Kh2 reaches the exact frame at ply 59. R8g2# is the recorded final move.

deferred.reason: Reserve this sound central contact mate. Timmermans–Carlsen already illustrates a knight-protected rook checking close to the king, and Niemann–Carlsen adds a check from farther away.
deferred.distinctness: White mates a king on e7 from the adjacent e6 square. The checking rook is protected by the knight; the second rook on d1 only restricts king flights on d7 and d8, so the learner must leave it where it is.
deferred.solutionVi: Re6# — Xe từ d6 đến e6, chiếu hết. Mã g5 bảo vệ Xe e6. Xe d1 khống chế d7 và d8, chặn đường Vua Đen sang cột d.
hintsVi: Xe d1 đang khống chế những ô nào bên cạnh Vua Đen?
Hãy giữ Xe d1 ở nguyên vị trí và tìm nước chiếu bằng Xe d6.

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: Removing Rd1 opens Kd7 and Kd8. The rook on e6 gives check and the g5-knight protects e6 from capture.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: All 40 legal roots checked. Re6# alone mates. Rd7+ allows Ke8 or Nxd7; Bxf6+ allows Ke8 or Rxf6.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: No legal replies or recaptures after the actual checkmate. No material conceded or offered in preparation.
reviewNotes.level: Direct one-move application with the second rook already covering the escape file.
reviewNotes.provenance: Replayed the complete Titled Tuesday game, Carlsen–Ibarra Jerez, 7 January 2025. After 29...Rf8, 30.Re6# is the played finish. Verified source ply 58, preceding FEN and PGN Mentor archive reference/checksum.

deferred.reason: Reserve this sound contact mate. The selected Carlsen–Cardoso and Shirov–Ehlvest games already cover choosing or coordinating rooks that can reach the same checking square.
deferred.distinctness: The two rooks stand side by side, and the supporting rook covers two retreat squares on its own file in addition to guarding the mating square. The other rook cannot simply trade roles.
deferred.solutionVi: Trắng chiếu hết bằng Rgf7#. Xe g7 sang f7 chiếu Vua ở f6. Xe e7 bảo vệ f7, đồng thời chặn e6 và e5. Nếu chọn Ref7+, Vua Đen thoát được về e6 hoặc e5.
hintsVi: Xe e7 vừa bảo vệ f7 vừa chặn các ô nào trên cột e?
Hãy tìm nước chiếu ở f7 mà vẫn giữ Xe trên cột e.

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: The f7 rook gives the contact check. Without Re7, Kxf7, Ke6 and Ke5 become legal.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: Rgf7# is the unique mate among 17 legal roots. Ref7+ leaves Ke6 and Ke5.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: The chosen mate has no legal reply or recapture and involves no material offer.
reviewNotes.level: Direct one-move rook choice on a shared rank, suitable for A.
reviewNotes.provenance: Replayed the full PGN Mentor Shirov archive game. Kf6 reaches the exact frame at ply 86 and Rgf7# was played.
